root_cause.text: In fib6_add_rt2node(), the code unconditionally dereferences `iter->fib6_nh` to check `fib_nh_gw_family`, but when a route is created with a nexthop ID (`iter->nh` non-NULL), the `fib6_nh` member is not allocated/valid, leading to an out-of-bounds read.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states: "When IPv6 route is created with RTA_NH_ID, struct fib6_info does not have the trailing struct fib6_nh. The cited commit started to check !iter->fib6_nh->fib_nh_gw_family ... If iter->nh is not NULL, rt6_qualify_for_ecmp() returns false anyway. Let's check iter->nh before reading iter->fib6_nh and avoid OOB read." The patch changes the condition from `!iter->fib6_nh->fib_nh_gw_family` to `(iter->nh || !iter->fib6_nh->fib_nh_gw_family)`, which avoids the invalid access when `iter->nh` is set.
